recommendations.title: Relaunch Top-Performing 'LEGIT SURE' Creative
recommendations.detail: The creative 'LEGIT SURE 100%' is your historical winner with 318 messages at a cost of 29.18 per message. Since current campaign costs have spiked to 87.28, relaunch this creative in a new campaign to stabilize the account's lead floor.

recommendations.title: Pivot to 'Xpander GLX AT' Ad Angle
recommendations.detail: The 'Xpander GLX AT | Low DP' ad shows an exceptional CTR of 8.22% and a message cost (32.54) that is 62% cheaper than the current campaign average. Move the majority of the 'JULY ADS 2026' budget into this specific ad variation.

recommendations.title: Broaden Targeting to Reduce CPMs
recommendations.detail: Current CPMs are critically high (355.78 to 445.75). The 'Metro South' ad set is likely too narrow. Expand targeting to include adjacent regions or use Advantage+ Detailed Targeting to allow Meta's algorithm to find cheaper inventory, aiming to bring CPMs back toward the historical 207.53 level.

recommendations.title: Audit 'JULY ADS 2026' Campaign Structure
recommendations.detail: The current top campaign is producing messages at 87.28 each, which is nearly 3x the cost of your top creative's lifetime average. If performance doesn't improve within 48 hours of creative optimization, pause this campaign and revert to the 'Multi Models' structure which shows better efficiency.
